title.es: El mismo mensaje con otra voz

es: Reconocer si un mensaje es formal, neutro o informal por su saludo, su vocabulario y su estructura.

teaching.en: Hi Leo, can you send me the file? Thanks!
teaching.es: Hola, Leo, ¿puedes enviarme el archivo? ¡Gracias!
teaching.explanationEs: Mensaje informal: saludo corto, can you y una exclamación.
teaching.audioText: Hi Leo, can you send me the file? Thanks!

teaching.en: Dear Mr Brown, could you please send me the file?
teaching.es: Estimado señor Brown, ¿podría enviarme el archivo, por favor?
teaching.explanationEs: Mensaje formal: Dear + título, could you y please.
teaching.audioText: Dear Mr Brown, could you please send me the file?

teaching.en: Thanks for the notes! Talk soon.
teaching.es: ¡Gracias por los apuntes! Hablamos pronto.
teaching.explanationEs: En un mensaje informal se usan frases cortas y despedidas como Talk soon.
teaching.audioText: Thanks for the notes! Talk soon.

teaching.en: I am afraid that I cannot attend the meeting.
teaching.es: Me temo que no puedo asistir a la reunión.
teaching.explanationEs: Formal: forma completa cannot, sin contracción, y la fórmula I am afraid that.
teaching.audioText: I am afraid that I cannot attend the meeting.

teaching.en: Thank you for your help. Kind regards, Ana.
teaching.es: Gracias por su ayuda. Saludos cordiales, Ana.
teaching.explanationEs: Kind regards es la despedida formal más habitual.
teaching.audioText: Thank you for your help. Kind regards, Ana.

prompt.es: ¿Qué mensaje está escrito en tono formal?

choices.text: Dear Ms Green, could you please call me tomorrow? Kind regards.
Hi Ms Green, can you call me tomorrow? Bye!
Call me tomorrow, thanks!

feedback.es: Dear + título, could you please y Kind regards son señales formales. Las otras dos opciones usan saludo informal, contracciones o exclamaciones.

hint.es: El saludo y la forma de pedir cambian según quién lee.

prompt.es: Completa: «Querida Sra. Smith:»

answer.text: Dear
accepted: Dear

feedback.es: Dear es el saludo con el que empieza un mensaje o una carta formal, seguido del título y el apellido.

hint.es: Es la palabra con que empieza un correo a alguien a quien no conoces bien.

es: Usar however, although, in addition y as a result para contrastar, añadir y expresar consecuencia, con su puntuación.

teaching.en: The hotel is cheap; however, it is far from the beach.
teaching.es: El hotel es barato; sin embargo, está lejos de la playa.
teaching.explanationEs: However une dos frases: va después de punto o punto y coma y lleva coma detrás.

teaching.audioText: The hotel is cheap; however, it is far from the beach.

teaching.en: Although it was raining, we played in the park.
teaching.es: Aunque llovía, jugamos en el parque.
teaching.explanationEs: Although une dos ideas en una sola frase y no se usa con but.
teaching.audioText: Although it was raining, we played in the park.

teaching.en: The room is big. In addition, it has a small kitchen.
teaching.es: La habitación es grande. Además, tiene una cocina pequeña.

es: Deducir a quién se dirige un texto o audio y elegir la respuesta cuyo tono corresponde.

prompt.es: Escribe el correo formal a la administración sobre el ruido (60 a 90 palabras).

answer.text: Dear Mr Jones, I am writing to complain about the noise in our building. Every night the music from the apartment next to mine is very loud until two in the morning. As a result, I cannot sleep and my children are tired at school. My neighbour told me that he would turn it down; however, the problem continues. In addition, other families also complain. I would like to ask you to solve this problem. Thank you for your help. Kind regards, Sara Lopez
accepted: Dear Mr Jones, I am writing to complain about the noise in our building. Every night the music from the apartment next to mine is very loud until two in the morning. As a result, I cannot sleep and my children are tired at school. My neighbour told me that he would turn it down; however, the problem continues. In addition, other families also complain. I would like to ask you to solve this problem. Thank you for your help. Kind regards, Sara Lopez

Dear Mr Jones, I am writing to complain about the noise in the building. The music from my neighbour is very loud every night until two in the morning. As a result, I cannot sleep and my children are tired at school. My neighbour said that he would turn it down, but the problem continues. In addition, other families complain too. I would like to ask you to solve this problem. Kind regards, Sara Lopez

Dear Mr Jones, I am writing to tell you about the noise in our building. Every night my neighbour plays very loud music until two in the morning. As a result, I cannot sleep and my children are tired at school. My neighbour told me that he would turn it down, but the problem continues. In addition, other families complain. Could you please solve this problem? Thank you for your help. Kind regards, Sara Lopez
